Container.Name: daemonsight-docker-reader
Container.Overview: The DaemonSight Docker reader. Unraid's API lists containers but not Docker images, volumes or build cache; this container reads them from Docker and answers the DaemonSight hub, and nothing else. It is the most privileged piece of DaemonSight: it holds the Docker socket, which is root on the server. Read SECURITY.md, "The Docker reader", before installing it. It publishes no port: create the network once (docker network create daemonsight), put the hub's container on it too (Network Type: Custom: daemonsight), and enter http://daemonsight-docker-reader:8467 and the token in the hub's Edit page for this server. Before the first start, make the token file (see docs/INSTALL.md, "Add the Docker reader to an Unraid server") and replace REPLACE_WITH_SOCKET_GID in Extra Parameters with the group id of /var/run/docker.sock (ls -ln /var/run/docker.sock); the container will not start until you do.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Docker's socket. Read-only here does not make the Docker API read-only: the reader only sends GET requests because its own code only can.

Config.Name: Token file
Config.Description: A file holding the bearer token the hub sends, owned by uid 10001 with mode 0600 (chown 10001:10001, chmod 600). Make one with: openssl rand -hex 32
